verdict.rationale: Issuing scoped API credentials is a fair question for a SaaS data platform with management APIs and an MCP server, so the axis applies. However, nothing in the evidence pack describes access tokens, permission scopes, or least-privilege credential issuance. The management APIs and the MCP server show programmatic access but do not show scoped credentials, so they earn no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
